name: Oskarn Post 114 Original
description: This listing is a geothermal flash evaporator listed with throughput 729 litres an hour, operating temperature 65 degrees Celsius, feed salinity 21 parts per thousand. Its remaining stated figures are media service 1424 hours, unit price set after acceptance, energy source gravity fed. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.

reviews.title: Bought this geothermal flash evaporator for 21 parts per thousand
reviews.text: Replaced a much older geothermal flash evaporator with this listing last season. We had a hard floor on feed salinity; 21 parts per thousand clears it. At 21 parts per thousand it does not need to stand out anywhere else.

reviews.title: Good, with one reservation about this listing
